goal: Let external applications and tests inspect step-by-step script execution in libbitcoinkernel
Enables tooling like script debuggers and prevents hidden errors in interpreter tests
agreement: General concept support for enabling script debugging and improved interpreter testing
Concept support noting significant benefits for testing (furszy, theStack)
Tested successfully by building a visualizer with Python bindings (elmeriniemela)
Unanswered author reply to objection on control-flow opcode reporting in inactive branches (w0xlt)

categories.name: kernel
why: P3 because it adds an optional diagnostic tool for external consumers rather than core node behavior
Downstream script debuggers and analyzers benefit, but the build-time feature is safely deferrable
